title: Social Connection in America
discussion_signal: The research relay treats weak community participation and limited time for connection as public-health and community-capacity issues, while inviting people to share practical ways they build connection. It shifts the frame from individual loneliness to social infrastructure.
linked_research_question: How do time scarcity and weak community participation constrain social connection, and which local practices can rebuild durable ties?
limits: The post does not establish that suggested practices cause connection gains
